integrity: The inequality and equality cases are proved analytically by a parity-class reduction on the three-cube. The checker only verifies finite Walsh bookkeeping and the equality-orbit classification. Search failure is not treated as proof of novelty.
scientific limitations: Real scalar homogeneous quadratic Rademacher chaoses with at most four variables only; no claim for complex coefficients, normed-space coefficients, or arbitrary dimension. The historical 1999 source of the conjecture was not available in full in the inspected public sources.
title: Four variables attain the sharp scalar quadratic Rademacher-chaos constant
